preprocessing: First 24 hours establish dominant five-minute phase from integer-valued CGM endpoints. Only that phase retained thereafter; fractional or out-of-range endpoints rejected; no gap filling. Published minute stream is interpolated, so native-observation provenance cannot be fully recovered. This is reconstructed-cadence research evaluation, not raw-device validation.
hba1c_unit: Percent, consistent with source cohort definitions and 4.6–8.5 values. Dictionary mmol/mol label is inconsistent.
